headline: Elon Musk's AI Wikipedia hasn't been updated in months
summary: Elon Musk's Grokipedia, an AI-generated encyclopedia, is stagnant. Reports indicate no updates since April 24th, over three months ago. Musk had promised Grokipedia would be a "massive improvement" over Wikipedia.

headline: X product chief Nikita Bier is leaving after one year
summary: Nikita Bier, X's head of product, is stepping down. He will transition to an advisory role, calling it a "demotion to a poster." His departure comes just over a year into the role.

headline: Ring's latest video doorbells are significantly cheaper
summary: Ring's Wired Doorbell Pro and Battery Doorbell Plus are on sale. The Wired Doorbell Pro is $199 ($50 off) at Amazon and Best Buy. These popular models are well-rounded options for home security.

headline: Uber CEO brushes off reports of a Waymo break-up
summary: Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi denies a Waymo partnership fraying. Despite Phoenix ending, they remain committed to Atlanta and Austin. Khosrowshahi insists the partnership is "very strong."

headline: BMW Owners Annoyed by Forced Spider-Man Ad in Car Infotainment
summary: BMW owners are frustrated by a new Spider-Man ad. The advertisement was forcibly integrated into their car's infotainment systems. Many users have expressed significant annoyance at the unprompted ad.

headline: Emily Wilson Slams Christopher Nolan's 'Odyssey' Adaptation
summary: Translator Emily Wilson criticizes Christopher Nolan's "The Odyssey" adaptation. She specifically targets his interpretation of Zeus' law. This marks another instance of Wilson's disapproval of the epic film.

headline: Google Is Killing Google Assistant on Android Devices Next Month
summary: Google will sunset Assistant on Android devices after September 4. Users will no longer be able to opt-out of Gemini. Gemini is now expected to fully replace Assistant, despite earlier user issues.

headline: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls Review So Far
summary: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is showing strong potential. The game appears poised to uphold Marvel's fighting legacy. An early review suggests a promising future for the title.

headline: Young Women Detail Rape, Assault at Army Training College
summary: Young women report rape, assault, and harassment at Army Foundation College. Incidents allegedly occurred at the Harrogate college when they were 17. The BBC report highlights serious allegations against the institution.

headline: Infantino Apologizes for Errors, Remains Fifa President
summary: Gianni Infantino apologized for errors in private investment plans. He received backing from senior executives to retain his position. Infantino will continue as Fifa president despite the controversy.

headline: Cambridge Professor Resigns Amid Plagiarism Row
summary: Prof. Jason Arday has resigned from the University of Cambridge. His resignation follows a significant plagiarism controversy. He stated stepping away was the "only way to bring this chapter to an end."

headline: Car Washes, Vape Shops Still Sponsoring Foreign Workers
summary: Certain businesses can still sponsor skilled foreign workers despite new visa rules. This includes car washes and vape shops, among others. New rules from July 2025 aimed to restrict sponsorship to graduate-level, higher-earning roles.
